title: Last Weekend - Múlt hétvégén
grammar: Past tense of weekend-activity verbs (kirándul, piknikezik, sportol); múlt hétvégén; group subjects take 3rd person plural

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can talk about weekend activities in the past tense using kirándul, piknikezik and sportol.
I can say múlt hétvégén and use the correct verb form when two people are named together.
